scenario.notes: 4 triage workers with 4 requests in flight each (INFERENCE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4), 2 matchers (leader + standby), simulated driver at SIM_TIME_SCALE=0.01, fleet of 43 vehicles (19 ambulances with 4 seats, 14 trucks with 20, 10 boats with 8) at 4 depots. With T8 group plans. Traces exported to Jaeger. The run started on commit 716d566 (T8). 31 minutes in, during the drain, both matchers were restarted one at a time on b7f3647, which makes the cut-off check use the same per-type reachability as T8; this let the last waiting tasks, on farm tracks unsuitable for road vehicles, be escalated NO_SURFACE_ROUTE instead of waiting with OVERDUE only.
